This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Elias, Lindsy, Malika, Shoshana

I prefer to avoid overlap with others, so please share your preferences so we can optimize coverage and minimize conflicts.

I am currently inclined towards ISSUE-0002::test (devops test) given my availability and skill match, assuming Elias will take ISSUE-0002::review. Malika, Shoshana, please advise if you have any conflicts or alternative preferences.

Hello everyone, I am focusing on critical priority backend subtasks such as review or docs for ISSUE-0001. I want to coordinate to avoid clashes and maximize coverage. I see Malika considering the backend implement task, which fits well with my plan.
